title: Existing obligations, no impairment.
bodyText: Nothing contained in this chapter shall impair or affect any outstanding notes, contracts, or obligations of the State or of the board of land and natural resources.
bodyHtml: §206-43  Existing obligations, no impairment.  Nothing contained in this chapter shall impair or affect any outstanding notes, contracts, or obligations of the State or of the board of land and natural resources. [L 1961, c 6, §41; Supp, §98J-41; HRS §206-43]
